name: lynkgrids
description: Lynkgrids is your LinkedIn CRM, the outreach tool that finally remembers your customers. From chat: find leads by ideal customer, check your connections, enrich contacts, run connection-plus-follow-up campaigns, and handle replies.

interface.shortDescription: Lynkgrids is your LinkedIn CRM, the outreach tool that finally remembers your customers.
interface.longDescription: Other tools send the message and leave you to track the relationship. Lynkgrids does both. It runs the LinkedIn outreach and keeps every conversation as a tracked lead. From Claude you can describe your ideal customer and get leads, score your own LinkedIn connections against it and add the fits to a list, enrich contacts from their profiles, launch a campaign on a list, comment on a prospect's latest post, and handle replies. Nothing goes to a real person until you have seen the message and said yes.
defaultPrompt: Find 50 Heads of Sales at B2B SaaS companies in India and add them to a list.
Check my LinkedIn connections and put everyone who fits my ideal customer into the list Q4 founders.
Who replied to my campaigns this week, and draft replies for them.
